itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and no in-kind exists to test: the v. 4.20 blank has NO in-kind checkbox column and NOT ONE cell on either schedule carries an in-kind marking, note or annotation. Both conventions therefore give the identical sums (2712.44 / 2712.44) and both close on the printed figures. Tested per filing, not inherited from the other v. 4.20 filing in this chunk (Tribe 17f4889b), which DOES carry in-kind and closes only WITH it.
itemized.escalation_note: Two 900 dpi escalations, both for the geometry proof rather than a doubtful glyph (every figure on this typed fillable form is machine type and legible at 200 dpi): the first and last transcribed amount cells of each schedule, plus the outside-the-grid control strip on p3. One reading worth recording: the Schedule B 'Subtotal for this page' cell prints a DOUBLED dollar sign — '$ $2,712.44' — because the filer typed his own $ into a field whose label already prints one; at 900 dpi its thousands separator is ambiguous between a comma and a period. Nothing turns on it: the gating figure is Box D on p4, which prints a clean $2,712.44, and the rows' own sum agrees, so no repair was made and no row amount is affected.

itemized.notes: Jeff P Wabel (page-face name; index.csv's channel label is 'Jeff Wabel'), 2022 cycle, 'Seven days preceding Convention' (radio filled on p1); amendment answered 'No'; Date and Date of Report both 'April 4, 2022'. Typed fillable modern_boxAF form, printed and scanned. FORM REVISION: the footer version string is illegible on this scan, but the blank is unambiguously the v. 4.20 family and NOT the newer 2022 blank — Schedule A's third column is 'Address and Zip Code' (not 'City and State'), there is NO in-kind checkbox column, the close box is UNLETTERED, and the cover offers FIVE report types with no End-of-Year. pdfinfo: 6 pages, letter, ALL /Rotate 0 — read before measuring per K1. Pages classified BY CONTENT: p1 cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, p4 Summary Page, p5 CHECKLIST DECOY, p6 blank. FOLIATION: the filer's own Page boxes read '1 of 4', '2 of 4', '3 of 4', '4 of 4' — so the FILING is four sheets and the two extra PDF pages are the clerk's checklist and a blank; the foliation is positive completeness evidence (the ADDENDUM E5 converse), and it also means pdfinfo's page count is not the filing's length. THE CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND AT p5, immediately after the genuine summary page at p4: the born-digital-clean 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' with every summary-page label, ZERO dollar figures, TWO staff-signed review copies on one sheet (Staff Signature #1 in red dated 4/4/22; Staff Signature #2 'JJ' dated 4/6/2022), and the corner box with 'Website' ticked, 'Network' and 'HOLD' unticked — the same HOLD revision as the Tribe filing in this chunk, reviewed on the same two dates by the same two hands. ROW-INDEX TRAPS: all six screened. First entry on band 1 on both schedules (crop-proved); no continuation lines; no voided rows; no banner; on Schedule A the one-band-past control rendered empty; on Schedule B the grid is FULL so the control was taken outside the grid and rendered the printed subtotal labels; and each interpolated band was crop-proved to hold exactly one entry, so no doubled band collapses two entries into one. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed — Schedule B's Provider/Vendor cells hold vendor names and its Purpose cells hold purposes; columns assignable by content. SUMMARY-BOX PAIRING SCREEN (ADDENDUM L1): the two sides carry the IDENTICAL figure (2,712.44 raised and 2,712.44 spent, closing at .00), so a crossed pairing would be invisible to arithmetic — but the pairing is confirmed by CONTENT, not by the boxes: Schedule A's rows are four named individual donors including the candidate, Schedule B's are fifteen vendors (Amazon, Costco, printers, fuel), and each schedule's own printed heading matches its content. OFFICE: the page's Office box is typed 'Sheriff', which AGREES with index.csv's 'County Sheriff'. NOTE Box A and the Balance at Close both print exactly '.00' with no leading digit and no dollar sign — transcribed as the page prints them, not normalized. PRIVACY: the county redacted the candidate's own address block and signature on the cover and the STREET portion of all four donor address cells on p2; the city/state text survives beside each bar and only city/state were carried. These are redacted BY THE COUNTY, not left empty by the filer.
